title: Active Portfolio profile-type count has insufficient light-mode contrast
cause: The global small muted color wins over the active dark-gradient button inherited white; axe marks short text incomplete. The case was not covered by a violations-only assertion.
recommendation: Owner should add a narrowly scoped active profile-type tab count color rule and verify both All/Clients active states light/dark. No global muted-token broadening.
notClaimed: No evidence of native or provider defect; no assertion that this contrast issue was introduced by the current patch.
